subject: ranger: handle longlong overflow properly (#52365)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: extends `convertPoint` overflow-tolerance to `mysql.TypeLonglong` so out-of-range BIGINT literals clamp to boundary and `excl` adjustment + `validInterval` correctly yield empty/full ranges (matching MySQL-style semantics for impossible comparisons) instead of planning errors. Later history on `upstream/master` further generalizes the same idea to other integer/float types, but nothing suggests a correctness regression specific to this commit.
